name: Camp Nowhere
source:
Unease fills your body as you make the journey to the camp you're going to be spending your entire summer at. You brush your feelings off as nothing, you're just being overly paranoid.

When someone turns up dead the next morning, you realise your feelings weren't misguided at all.

Do you think you can save your new friends from the killer on the loose? Or will you all succumb to the same fate?

[From [url=https://nightpxel.itch.io/camp-nowhere]Itch.io[/url]]
